headline: Indian Rupee Crosses 93 Against US Dollar for First Time in Seven Months
summary: The Indian rupee gained for a fifth straight day to trade above 93 per US dollar, backed by foreign investment inflows and positive equity sentiment.
why: The rupee's valuation reflects international capital flows and broader foreign exchange reserve dynamics in India.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Sustained foreign portfolio inflows strengthened the Indian rupee against the US dollar.
